'''Drom Virbilge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked for the [[Thaereian military]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], serving as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Thaereian Military Special Ops]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]] discovered evidence of three data transmitters that the [[Metatheran Cartel]] had covertly placed at strategic locations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. A group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] working for [[the Syndicate]] were sent to attack [[Krol-Pek]], a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who Nrump had asked to decrypt some transmissions from the transmitters, to prevent the discovery of the transmitters, and Virbilge learned of their plans. From the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varna Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], where Virbilge was operating undercover, the Thaereian contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Morton]], a contact that he had within the [[Office of Peace and Security]], warning him that there was going to be some trouble at Krol-Pek's house. He also gave Morton a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] containing a message intended for the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who had obtained a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing Nrump's findings. In the message, Virbilge stated that information contained within the datapad threatened the security of the entire [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and he urged the agents to hand the device in to the Thaereian military. He also fitted the datacard with a type of electrically activated acid, to destroy the message after it had been read by the agents.
